This is a bounded digest of the visible native agent conversation /root/perf_issue_forward and its saved artifacts. It is not a complete host transcript. T3 configuration reads expose the containing thread selection, not a separately attested native child identity. No private transcript stores or other evaluation histories were consulted.

The parent assigned the realistic one-off Perf issue request with isolated app and evidence write scope, explicit inherited model configuration, no commits or publication, two descendant slots and required reviews. The source skill was read in full. The upstream-fidelity policy and Unslop were read. An initial combined discovery output was too large, so selected references were read again in smaller calls. Earliest read-only records were not all captured completely as standalone files. bootstrap-limitations.txt records that failure.

The agent opened the host plan with all six verbatim Perf issue steps before runtime measurements. It read setup, configuration, execution, control-cli, benchmark checklist, How and applicable principles. Live capabilities and current selection were captured. The initial app matched read-only baseline hashes. The agent wrote the provisional claim before profiling. Initial uptime and core count were observed before the first profile, with a later full environment record. CLI CPU profiling and an unprofiled diagnostic timing were separate. The baseline tests passed. Profile parsing and the separate parse probe identified summarize and repeated rules parsing. These runs are retained in commands/baseline-*.json.

The agent started decisions.tsv during baseline analysis and wrote the four throughput items before app editing. The host plan also contained the checkpoint. A fresh inherited How explainer read source and diagnostic artifacts and returned how.md. The agent inspected the report and chose mantra two after recording why the first mantra had no identified unused work. A local lazy primitive-string cache retained the existing function boundary and data structures. Architect was not run because no signature, ownership or boundary change was planned.

The agent preflighted perf-issue using a fresh live catalog, saved a consolidated brief, and spawned one fresh inherited implementation child. The child read the full mode and changed only summary.cjs and summary.test.cjs. It retained an initial failed python launcher command. Eight tests and supplied CLI validation passed. It returned terminal, with no descendants. The agent inspected the exact diff and froze the source snapshot before final checks.

The global skill-creator requirement prompted a scope question to the parent. The parent clarified that the advertised host skill-creator entrypoint was permitted read-only, since the jstack path restriction only selected the jstack version. The agent read that entrypoint at 2026-10-17T00:01:05Z. Initial briefs preceded that read. decisions.tsv preserves this ordering rather than claiming the requirement was satisfied earlier.

A fresh Comment Sicko reviewer received its complete specialized prompt, frozen scope and explicit configuration. It returned zero scoped comments or suppressions, zero proposed deletions, no MUST KILL flags and an empty private diff. The parent inspected and accepted that report. Some comment-review bootstrap commands were replayed into its record and labeled. No source edits resulted.

The agent independently ran eight tests, 164 CommonJS comparisons and eight CLI scenarios, then captured the post-fix profile and parse probe. The profile was excluded from timings. benchmark.py ran five serial alternating baseline/app pairs with complete output, stderr, exit and work validation. All ten outputs exactly matched expected.json and accounted for all 80,000 events. The median reduction was 93.8691707685 percent. The agent logged the decision to stop optimizing after the first passing candidate and froze app writes. Raw evidence remains under benchmark/ and commands/.

The outer parent was told that timings were finished and app writes were frozen. It performed its own checks outside this evidence tree and later reported a pass. Those parent results are excluded from this agent's measured claim and assessment. The independent code reviewer uses a fresh inherited judgment-and-prose selection, and may run bounded compatibility probes only under its own evidence directory. Its final status is recorded separately when it returns.

The report draft distinguishes the measured local target from full mode conformance. It discloses synthetic workload scope, no model-family diversity, no universal equivalence under arbitrary built-in replacement, earliest command-capture gaps, child replayed reads, the retained failed command and late skill-creator read. No source, setting, repository, installation, commit or publication outside the authorized app/evidence/scratch scope was written. A final independent trail review remains necessary before delivery.
